issuing_body: U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota
title: United States v. Ross - Preliminary Order of Forfeiture, ECF 55
supports: Real property at 312 Chippenham Lane, Willernie, Minnesota is forfeited to the United States.
A money judgment forfeiture of $1,241,455 is entered against Sharon Ross, with credit for the net forfeited value of each asset forfeited from her.
The order becomes final as to the defendant at sentencing.
does_not_support: The $1,241,455 money judgment is lower than the $2,837,491 money judgment she consented to in her plea agreement (ECF 43); the order, not the plea, is the operative figure.
It does not show the house was sold or any dollar realized.
